## Start Your EC2 Cluster Now

Do this **before** we dive into the lecture — the cluster needs time to fully initialize.

```bash
# SSH into your EC2 instance
ssh -i ~/.ssh/your-key.pem ubuntu@<your-ec2-ip>

# In the project/ directory, start your Spark cluster
cd ~/project
bash start-cluster.sh

# Verify Spark UI is reachable at http://<ec2-ip>:8080
# Keep this terminal open
```

::: {.callout-tip}
## Cluster check
Once started, confirm you see **Spark Master** in the browser at port 8080 and at least one worker is registered. If your cluster is already stopped from last week, allow 2–3 minutes for full startup.
:::
